_help.note: Lines inside _help are documentation only. The provider ignores them. Keep text values inside double quotes and do not remove commas between entries.

title_language.description: Preferred series title. If unavailable, the provider automatically falls back to another available title.

voice_actor_language.description: Preferred voice-actor language exactly as MAL reports it. Japanese is recommended for anime. Other MAL language labels may also work.

voice_actor_fallback.description: When true, use the first available voice actor if nobody is listed in the preferred language.

cast_image.description: Choose whether Plex cast thumbnails use the anime character image or the voice actor photo.

include_cast.description: Import character and voice-actor cast entries.

include_writers.description: Import staff recognised as writers or script staff.

include_themes.description: Import MAL themes into Plex genres.

include_demographics.description: Import MAL demographics such as Shounen or Seinen into Plex genres.

include_additional_posters.description: Add all additional MAL pictures to Plex's Poster picker.

poster_as_square_art.description: Use the default MAL poster as Plex Square Art.

include_background.description: Background download is currently intentionally unsupported. Leave false to let Plex use its gradient.

rating_source.description: Controls which badge Plex displays beside the MAL score. The numeric score still comes from MAL.
